ppda.definition: opponent open-play passes starting >= 42 m from the pressing team's goal line / pressing team's tackles (player without ball control), interceptions and fouls in the same zone; events without coordinates use the tracked ball position

shape.method: exact dynamic-programming 1-D k-means (k=3) on outfield depth; Andrew monotone-chain hull

physical.note: official S column (km/h) from the provider; app speeds are a 7-frame Savitzky–Golay derivative of positions, clamped at 12 m/s
